just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb3 and dwells most on Gb in Daramad. Kereshme (0:23.4) introduces B, centred on Gb. The line peaks at Gb4 (375.1 Hz) at 1:27.0. It closes on Gb4, not the tonic (B2 → Gb4 → Gb4 → Ds4 → E4 → Gb4).
